scope: Deny-by-default promotion ledger, repository evidence-path verifier and operator runbook for ATP laboratories. The laboratory ledger is not the authoritative capability registry and cannot itself promote a capability.
core_invariant: No ATP laboratory becomes a supported production capability because code exists, CI is green, a PR is open, a ledger entry exists or documentation describes it. Promotion requires the authoritative capability registry plus exact evidence binding, independent review, readiness synchronization and post-registry protected CI.

experimental PR treated as supported runtime
source PR number treated as promotion
controls: authoritative registry path explicitly fixed to mesh/config/capabilities.json

risks: passing tests bypass independent review
reuse pre-registry CI after claim change
cumulative CI hides missing promotion evidence
controls: promotion_ready requires independent review + registry + exact binding + no blockers
runbook requires exact post-registry candidate rerun

risks: roadmap or threat model presented as implementation
runbook presented as runtime enforcement
non-claim language silently removed
controls: in-tree entries require implementation + strict validator/schema + tests + threat model + runbook + verifier/conformance paths
production claim flag cannot be true on non-promoted entry

risks: A7 green branch treated as composed with A1-A10 stack
independent green PRs assumed integration-tested
controls: separate branch must carry separate-branch-not-composed blocker

implemented entry lacks evidence

known_nonclaims: A11a does not promote any ATP capability.
A11a does not perform or substitute for independent security review.
A11a does not prove GitHub workflow IDs are authentic beyond the repository record; protected CI remains independently inspectable evidence.
A11a does not compose the separate A7 branch into the current stack.
A11a does not resolve the technical blockers named by partial A3/A4/A5/A6/A9/A10 laboratories.
A11a grants no authority and changes no effect path.
next_gates: run protected CI on the A11a ledger/verifier itself
obtain independent security review before any authoritative registry transition
compose A7 and resolve A3b/A5b/full-A6 blockers before broad ATP claims
when a capability is actually approved, add the authoritative registry entry and exact evidence binding atomically then rerun protected CI
